```text
def ass_doc(font_family, events):
    return f"""[Script Info]
ScriptType: v4.00+
PlayResX: {PLAY_W}
PlayResY: {PLAY_H}
WrapStyle: 0
ScaledBorderAndShadow: yes

[V4+ Styles]
Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Encoding
Style: Cap,{font_family},116,&H00FFFFFF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H78000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,9,4,2,60,60,480,1
Style: Title,{font_family},128,&H0000E5FF,&H000000FF,&H00000000,&H78000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,9,4,8,60,60,170,1

[Events]
Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text
""" + "\n".join(events) + "\n"


# ---------- 3. video: one cached clip per scene ----------
def shot_times(timed, total):
    """Per scene: cut points (seconds). A scene starts CUT_LEAD before its first line's voice; inside a scene
    every new speaker's line also starts a shot CUT_LEAD early; long stretches are split every ~SHOT_LEN.
    A line with "shot" in lines.json ("wide" or [x, y, zoom(, crop_x, crop_y)]) gets that one shot for its whole
    stretch; "shots": [[spec, seconds], ..., [spec, null]] splits the stretch (last one takes the rest).
    Returns (scene, cut points, per-shot override or None)."""
    scenes = []
    for i, line in enumerate(timed):
        t = 0.0 if i == 0 else line["start"] - CUT_LEAD
        if not scenes or scenes[-1][0] != line["scene"]:
            scenes.append([line["scene"], [t], [i]])
        elif line["speaker"] != timed[i - 1]["speaker"]:
            scenes[-1][1].append(t)
            scenes[-1][2].append(i)
    out = []
    for k, (sc, cuts, owners) in enumerate(scenes):
        end = scenes[k + 1][1][0] if k + 1 < len(scenes) else total
        pts = cuts + [end]
        fine, tags = [pts[0]], []
        for a, b, own in zip(pts, pts[1:], owners):
            if timed[own].get("shots"):
                t = a
                for spec, secs in timed[own]["shots"]:
                    end = b if secs is None else min(b, t + secs)
                    if end > t:
                        fine.append(end)
                        tags.append(spec)
                        t = end
                fine[-1] = b
                continue
            if timed[own].get("shot"):
                fine.append(b)
                tags.append(timed[own]["shot"])
                continue
            n = max(1, min(round((b - a) / SHOT_LEN), int((b - a) / MIN_SHOT)))
            fine += [a + (b - a) * j / n for j in range(1, n + 1)]
            tags += [None] * n
        if len(fine) == 2 and tags[0] is None and fine[1] - fine[0] >= 2 * MIN_SHOT:  # at least wide + close
            fine.insert(1, (fine[0] + fine[1]) / 2)
            tags.append(None)
        out.append((sc, fine, tags))
    return out


def plan_scenes(P, timed, total, prof, font_family, final_title, title_secs=None):
    """Everything needed to render each scene clip, plus its cache hash."""
    focus = P["focus"]
    fps, plans = prof["fps"], []
    shots_all = shot_times(timed, total)
    for idx, (sc, cuts, tags) in enumerate(shots_all):
        fcuts = [round(c * fps) for c in cuts]  # one global frame grid -> no drift between clips
        t0 = fcuts[0] / fps
        spec = focus.get(str(sc), [])
        closes, wide = (spec["closes"], spec.get("wide", True)) if isinstance(spec, dict) else (spec, True)
        # 1 shot: close-up matters more; "wide": false (scene sharing an image with another) -> close-ups only
        cycle = closes if (closes and (len(cuts) == 2 or not wide)) else ["wide"] + closes
        shots, desc = [], []
        for k in range(len(cuts) - 1):
            n = fcuts[k + 1] - fcuts[k]
            shot = tags[k] or cycle[k % len(cycle)]
            if shot == "wide":
                move = MOVE_CYCLE[(idx + k) % len(MOVE_CYCLE)]
                z, x, y = (e.format(n=n) for e in MOVES[move])
                desc.append(move)
            else:
                # x, y: inside the frame-shaped window; optional crop_x/crop_y: where that window sits on a wider or
                # taller image (subject centre, 0-1; default centre) - e.g. a 9:16 Short from 16:9 story images
                fx, fy, zc, *crop = shot
                z = f"{zc}+{zc * 0.06:.3f}*on/{n}"  # slow push-in on the close-up
                x = f"max(0,min(iw-iw/zoom,{fx}*iw-iw/zoom/2))"
                y = f"max(0,min(ih-ih/zoom,{fy}*ih-ih/zoom/2))"
                desc.append(f"close{zc}" + (f"@x{crop[0]}" if crop else ""))
            shots.append((n, z, x, y) + (tuple(crop) if shot != "wide" and crop else ()))
        lines = [l for l in timed if l["scene"] == sc]
        ass = None
        if P["burn"]:
            ev = [f"Dialogue: 0,{ass_time(s - t0)},{ass_time(e - t0)},Cap,,0,0,0,,{txt}"
                  for l in lines if l["words"] for s, e, txt in caption_chunks(l)]
            if idx == len(shots_all) - 1 and final_title:
                t_end = fcuts[-1] / fps - t0
                t_beg = max(0.0, t_end - title_secs) if title_secs else 0.0  # e.g. a 2 s end card only
                ev.append(f"Dialogue: 1,{ass_time(t_beg)},{ass_time(t_end)},Title,,0,0,0,,"
                          f"{{\\fad(300,0)}}{final_title}")
            ass = ass_doc(font_family, ev)
        img = P["image_for"](sc)
        key = sha(RENDER_VERSION, json.dumps(prof, sort_keys=True), sha(img.read_bytes()),
                  [l["audio_hash"] for l in lines], json.dumps(shots), ass)
        plans.append({"scene": sc, "t0": t0, "t1": fcuts[-1] / fps, "frames": fcuts[-1] - fcuts[0],
                      "shots": shots, "ass": ass, "img": img, "key": key, "desc": desc})
    return plans


def render_scene(p, prof, clip: Path, work: Path):
    w, h, fps = prof["w"], prof["h"], prof["fps"]
    ass_name = f"scene_{p['scene']:02d}_{p['key']}.ass"
    if p["ass"]:
        (work / ass_name).write_text(p["ass"], encoding="utf-8")
    subs = f",subtitles=filename={ass_name}:fontsdir=fonts" if p["ass"] else ""
    n = len(p["shots"])
    pre = f"[0:v]scale={w * 2}:{h * 2}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase"
    fc = [pre + (f",split={n}" + "".join(f"[i{k}]" for k in range(n)) if n > 1 else "[i0]")]
    for k, (d, z, x, y, *crop) in enumerate(p["shots"]):
        cx, cy = (list(crop) + [0.5, 0.5])[:2]  # frame-shaped window on the image, centred on (cx, cy)
        win = (f"crop={w * 2}:{h * 2}:x='max(0,min(iw-ow,{cx}*iw-ow/2))':y='max(0,min(ih-oh,{cy}*ih-oh/2))'")
        fc.append(f"[i{k}]{win},zoompan=z='{z}':x='{x}':y='{y}':d={d}:s={w}x{h}:fps={fps}[z{k}]")
    fc.append("".join(f"[z{k}]" for k in range(n)) + (f"concat=n={n}:v=1:a=0" if n > 1 else "null")
              + f"{subs},scale=out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p,setsar=1,"
                f"setparams=range=tv:color_primaries=bt709:color_trc=bt709:colorspace=bt709[out]")
    tmp = clip.with_suffix(".part.mp4")
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", p["img"], "-filter_complex", ";".join(fc), "-map", "[out]", "-frames:v", p["frames"],
         "-c:v", "libx264", *prof["enc"], "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-color_range", "tv", "-colorspace", "bt709",
         "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-r", fps,
         "-video_track_timescale", fps * 1000, tmp], cwd=work)
    tmp.replace(clip)
```

```text
def music_offset(f: Path, a, b, windows):
    """Seconds into the track to start a segment [a, b] so no music-only pause (plus PAUSE_LEAD before it) lands
    in a near-silent gap of the track (e.g. between piano phrases). 0 when the segment has no pause."""
    wins = [(max(s, a), min(e, b)) for s, e in windows if e > a and s < b]
    if not wins:
        return 0.0
    lev = track_levels(f)
    n = len(lev)
    idx = [i for s, e in wins if len(i := np.arange(int((s - a) * 10), int((e - a) * 10)))]
    if not idx:
        return 0.0
    score = lambda off: min(lev[(i + int(off * 10)) % n].min() for i in idx)
    ok = np.median(lev) - 10  # within 10 dB of the track's usual level counts as audible
    if score(0) >= ok:
        return 0.0
    return float(max(np.arange(0, 20.01, 0.25), key=lambda off: (min(score(off), ok), -off)))


def build_audio(voice, total, events, meta, work: Path, two_pass: bool, below_db: float):
    """Voice + music (one track, or a track per mood with crossfades) at a fixed level under the voice + stings;
    music muted in any music_silent window. Also writes music.wav (music stem) for the level check."""
    v_lufs = integrated_lufs(voice)
    segs = music_segments(events, meta, total)
    lufs_of = {}
    inputs = ["-i", voice]
    fc = [f"[0:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo[v]"]
    for k, (a, b, f) in enumerate(segs):
        if f not in lufs_of:
            lufs_of[f] = integrated_lufs(f, 60)
        gain = v_lufs - below_db - lufs_of[f]
        last = k == len(segs) - 1
        length = (b - a) + (0 if last else MUSIC_XFADE)  # overlap into the next mood = crossfade
        fade_out = f"afade=t=out:st={length - (1.5 if last else MUSIC_XFADE):.2f}:d={1.5 if last else MUSIC_XFADE}"
        fade_in = f"afade=t=in:d={MUSIC_XFADE}," if k else ""
        ms = int(a * 1000)
        off = music_offset(f, a, b, events.get("pauses", []))
        if off:
            print(f"  music: {Path(f).stem} starts {off:.2f}s in (pause falls on an audible part)")
        inputs += ["-stream_loop", "-1", *(["-ss", f"{off:.2f}"] if off else []), "-i", f]
        fc.append(f"[{k + 1}:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,atrim=0:{length:.3f},"
                  f"volume={gain:.2f}dB,{fade_in}{fade_out},adelay={ms}|{ms}[mu{k}]")
    mute = "+".join(f"between(t,{a:.2f},{b:.2f})" for a, b in events["music_silent"]) or "0"
    fc.append("".join(f"[mu{k}]" for k in range(len(segs)))
              + f"amix=inputs={len(segs)}:duration=longest:normalize=0,volume='if({mute},0,1)':eval=frame,"
                f"asplit=2[m][mstem]")
    if len(segs) > 1:
        print("  music: " + " -> ".join(f"{Path(f).stem}@{a:.0f}s" for a, _, f in segs))
    mix_in, n_in = "[v][m]", len(segs) + 1
    for k, (at, kind) in enumerate(events["sfx"]):
        f = SFX_DIR / meta["sfx"][kind]
        gain = v_lufs - SFX_BELOW_VOICE_DB - integrated_lufs(f)
```

```text
## 11. Review limits and severity
Every problem Munshi reports is marked BLOCKER or MINOR.

BLOCKER (never waived, in any round):
- Copyright (section 10), wrong channel, any secret exposed.
- Wrong character on screen for a line, wrong voice for a character, a line missing or cut off.
- Caption more than 1 s away from its line, or caption text not matching what is spoken.
- Loudness outside -14 LUFS ±1, true peak above -1.0 dBFS, audible clipping or leaked outside audio.
- Wrong resolution/codec, or a preview file used as final.
- Thumbnail: broken Hindi matras, spoiler, unreadable text, important thing in the bottom-right corner.
- Metadata: title over 100 chars, more than 15 hashtags, missing CC BY credit, "for kids" wording (title, thumbnail, description or tags), mystery answer revealed.
- Length outside ±10% of the approved preview length.
- Story problem: moral missing or a scene that contradicts the script.

MINOR (everything else that breaks a RULES limit only slightly), e.g.: caption off by 0.3–1 s, caption shorter than 0.4 s, music level within 3 dB of target, thumbnail text slightly under the size rule, small silent gaps, missing colour tags, tiny cosmetic issues.
Taste points (pacing feel, colour choice, music phrase) are "Note" only and never count as problems.

Rounds:
- Round 1 (R1): full review for that stage; BLOCKER and MINOR both come back as FIX (free) or ASK (paid).
- Round 2 (R2): re-check only what changed and what failed in R1.
- After R2: if any BLOCKER remains → ASK the user, stop. If only MINOR remain → verdict "PASS-WITH-NOTES": the stage is passed and the pipeline moves on to the next step (including upload when the user has approved it). No third round.
- Every MINOR waived after R2 is written to channels/<key>/carry_over.md (project, issue, suggested fix). Before the next video's build, the builder reads carry_over.md and fixes those causes in the pipeline, then marks them done.

These limits never weaken: copyright (section 10), channel ID check, secrets, and the full pre-upload check.
At the end of each review, add one line to channels/<key>/log.md with the round (R1/R2), verdict and approximate time taken.
```

```text
    return plans


def render_scene(p, prof, clip: Path, work: Path):
    w, h, fps = prof["w"], prof["h"], prof["fps"]
    ass_name = f"scene_{p['scene']:02d}_{p['key']}.ass"
    if p["ass"]:
        (work / ass_name).write_text(p["ass"], encoding="utf-8")
    subs = f",subtitles=filename={ass_name}:fontsdir=fonts" if p["ass"] else ""
    n = len(p["shots"])
    pre = f"[0:v]scale={w * 2}:{h * 2}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase"
    fc = [pre + (f",split={n}" + "".join(f"[i{k}]" for k in range(n)) if n > 1 else "[i0]")]
    for k, (d, z, x, y, *crop) in enumerate(p["shots"]):
        cx, cy = (list(crop) + [0.5, 0.5])[:2]  # frame-shaped window on the image, centred on (cx, cy)
        win = (f"crop={w * 2}:{h * 2}:x='max(0,min(iw-ow,{cx}*iw-ow/2))':y='max(0,min(ih-oh,{cy}*ih-oh/2))'")
        fc.append(f"[i{k}]{win},zoompan=z='{z}':x='{x}':y='{y}':d={d}:s={w}x{h}:fps={fps}[z{k}]")
    fc.append("".join(f"[z{k}]" for k in range(n)) + (f"concat=n={n}:v=1:a=0" if n > 1 else "null")
              + f"{subs},scale=out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p,setsar=1,"
                f"setparams=range=tv:color_primaries=bt709:color_trc=bt709:colorspace=bt709[out]")
    tmp = clip.with_suffix(".part.mp4")
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", p["img"], "-filter_complex", ";".join(fc), "-map", "[out]", "-frames:v", p["frames"],
         "-c:v", "libx264", *prof["enc"], "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-color_range", "tv", "-colorspace", "bt709",
         "-color_primaries", "bt709", "-color_trc", "bt709", "-r", fps,
         "-video_track_timescale", fps * 1000, tmp], cwd=work)
    tmp.replace(clip)


def build_video(plans, prof, cache_dir: Path, work: Path):
    todo = [p for p in plans if not (cache_dir / f"scene_{p['scene']:02d}_{p['key']}.mp4").exists()]
    for p in plans:
        state = "NEW" if p in todo else "cache"
        print(f"  scene {p['scene']:2d}: {p['t0']:6.2f}-{p['t1']:6.2f}s  {state:5s}  {' | '.join(p['desc'])}")
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(2, (os.cpu_count() or 4) // 2)) as pool:
        list(pool.map(lambda p: render_scene(p, prof, cache_dir / f"scene_{p['scene']:02d}_{p['key']}.mp4", work),
                      todo))
    listing = [f"file '{(cache_dir / f'scene_{p['scene']:02d}_{p['key']}.mp4').as_posix()}'" for p in plans]
    (work / "scenes.txt").write_text("\n".join(listing), encoding="utf-8")
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", "scenes.txt", "-c", "copy", "video.mp4"], cwd=work)
    return len(plans) - len(todo), len(todo)


# ---------- 4. audio mix + loudness ----------
def pick_music(meta):
    if meta.get("music"):
        return MUSIC_DIR / meta["music"]
```

|---|---|---|

| 3 | Crop option | Har shot me ab crop position di ja sakti hai. Long 01 aur Case 01 par asar nahi: dono ka `--plan` saaf aaya, aur unke test render me saare scenes **cache se** aaye, yaani unki render keys nahi badli. |
| 4 | Scene 22 | Sirf Ghasita ka chehra, haath aur sikka dikhte hain. Kadhai ka andar ka hissa frame me nahi. |
| 5 | publish_at | `2026-10-20T21:00:00+05:30` `meta.json` me hai, Long 01 se 2 ghante baad. |

**Ek galti maine khud pakdi:** pehle preview me "मेरा सोना!" par Ghasita aadha kat raha tha, kyunki maine image me unki jagah galat padhi thi. Munshi ko bhejne se pehle hi theek kar diya.

## Munshi ka review
**R1: FIX.** Do problem mili, dono free me theek ki:
- **B1 (BLOCKER):** scene 22 me neeche kadhai ke andar ka hissa aur mitti ka dher thoda dikh raha tha, yaani twist ka ishaara. Crop thoda upar kiya.
- **M1 (MINOR):** hook me Chhotu ka chehra dikh raha tha, toh lagta ki line wo bol raha hai. Ab sirf kadhai dikhti hai.

Baaki sab theek tha:
- Music voice se **13.0 LU** neeche, target 12–14 ke andar.
- Loudness -13.8 LUFS, true peak -1.1 dBFS.
- Captions bolne se match karte hain aur neeche ke 20% hisse se upar hain.
- Copyright aur metadata: koi "kids" shabd nahi, 4 hashtags.

**R2: PASS.** Munshi ne final resolution par push-in ke aakhir tak check kiya. Mitti ya kadhai ka andar ka hissa kisi frame me nahi dikhta, aur hook me koi chehra nahi.

**Sharpness:** Munshi ke hisaab se final me thoda soft dikhega, kyunki hook 4.25x aur cliffhanger 5x bada hota hai. Par moti outline wali 2D art phone par theek lagegi. **Isliye ASK nahi rakha.** Fir bhi zyada saaf chahiye toh option wahi hai: scene 16 aur 22 ki nayi vertical images, ₹6.48. Munshi ise zaroori nahi maanta.

RULES section 8 kehta hai ki video **upload ke din hi** publish ho. Isliye 20 Oct 21:00 tabhi niyam ke mutabik hai jab upload 20 Oct ko ho. Agar pehle upload karna ho, toh Long 01 ki tarah advance schedule ke liye aapki "ha" chahiye.

```text
## 10. Copyright (STRICT — any violation is FIX and blocks upload)
- Every external file used in any video (music, sound effect, font, image, footage, voice) must have a row in `shared/assets_license.csv`: path, source_url, author, license, attribution_text, date_added. No row = not allowed.
- Allowed licences only: CC0; CC BY 4.0 (with exact credit in the description); SIL OFL (fonts); YouTube Audio Library tracks (follow their attribution note); our own Gemini-generated images/voices; our own recordings.
- Never allowed: CC BY-NC (non-commercial, conflicts with monetization), CC BY-ND (we edit/mix), CC BY-SA, "free for personal use", Freesound "Sampling+", unknown source, anything ripped from YouTube/Spotify/Instagram/films/TV, Bollywood or any commercial song (even hummed or sung by TTS), Google/Pinterest images.
- Freesound: licence is per sound. Check each file's own licence page; only CC0 or CC BY 4.0.
- Content: no real brand logos, no film/TV/cartoon characters (Chhota Bheem, Motu Patlu, Disney, etc.), no celebrity likeness, no copied song lyrics, no copied text from modern books. Old folk tales (Panchatantra, Jataka, Akbar-Birbal) are public domain, but we always write our own version, never copy a modern retelling.
- Image prompts never name a studio, franchise or living artist ("Pixar style", "Ghibli style", etc.).
- Before upload, Munshi checks: every audio/image/font file in the final build is in the register, every CC BY item is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks, and no source audio from outside our pipeline is in the mix.
- After upload: if YouTube Studio shows any copyright claim or strike, stop all new uploads and tell the user. CC music sometimes gets false Content ID claims; dispute only with the licence proof from the register, after the user agrees.

## 11. Review limits and severity
Every problem Munshi reports is marked BLOCKER or MINOR.

BLOCKER (never waived, in any round):
- Copyright (section 10), wrong channel, any secret exposed.
- Wrong character on screen for a line, wrong voice for a character, a line missing or cut off.
- Caption more than 1 s away from its line, or caption text not matching what is spoken.
- Loudness outside -14 LUFS ±1, true peak above -1.0 dBFS, audible clipping or leaked outside audio.
- Wrong resolution/codec, or a preview file used as final.
- Thumbnail: broken Hindi matras, spoiler, unreadable text, important thing in the bottom-right corner.
- Metadata: title over 100 chars, more than 15 hashtags, missing CC BY credit, "for kids" wording (title, thumbnail, description or tags), mystery answer revealed.
- Length outside ±10% of the approved preview length.
- Story problem: moral missing or a scene that contradicts the script.

MINOR (everything else that breaks a RULES limit only slightly), e.g.: caption off by 0.3–1 s, caption shorter than 0.4 s, music level within 3 dB of target, thumbnail text slightly under the size rule, small silent gaps, missing colour tags, tiny cosmetic issues.
Taste points (pacing feel, colour choice, music phrase) are "Note" only and never count as problems.

Rounds:
- Round 1 (R1): full review for that stage; BLOCKER and MINOR both come back as FIX (free) or ASK (paid).
- Round 2 (R2): re-check only what changed and what failed in R1.
- After R2: if any BLOCKER remains → ASK the user, stop. If only MINOR remain → verdict "PASS-WITH-NOTES": the stage is passed and the pipeline moves on to the next step (including upload when the user has approved it). No third round.
- Every MINOR waived after R2 is written to channels/<key>/carry_over.md (project, issue, suggested fix). Before the next video's build, the builder reads carry_over.md and fixes those causes in the pipeline, then marks them done.

These limits never weaken: copyright (section 10), channel ID check, secrets, and the full pre-upload check.
At the end of each review, add one line to channels/<key>/log.md with the round (R1/R2), verdict and approximate time taken.
```

Analyse tempo ratio, pitch, edges, gaps

```bash
cd /d/Story-Channel; R=channels/dadi-ki-kahaniyan/stories/001_lalchi-halwai/shorts/short_01_jadui-kadhai/review/r3; cat > $R/an.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, wave, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, r"D:\Story-Channel\scripts")
import make_short as m
from pathlib import Path
S = Path(r"D:\Story-Channel\channels\dadi-ki-kahaniyan\stories\001_lalchi-halwai")
sh = S/"shorts/short_01_jadui-kadhai"; W = sh/"output/short_01_jadui-kadhai_work"
lines = json.load(open(sh/"lines.json", encoding="utf8"))
def rd(p):
    with wave.open(str(p)) as w:
        sr=w.getframerate(); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
        if w.getnchannels()>1: x=x.reshape(-1,w.getnchannels()).mean(1)
    return x,sr
def f0(x,sr):
    # median autocorr pitch over voiced frames
    hop=int(.02*sr); n=int(.04*sr); ps=[]
    for i in range(0,len(x)-n,hop):
        f=x[i:i+n]; 
        if np.sqrt(np.mean(f**2))<0.03: continue
        f=f-f.mean(); c=np.correlate(f,f,'full')[n-1:]
        lo,hi=int(sr/400),int(sr/70); k=lo+np.argmax(c[lo:hi])
        if c[k]>0.4*c[0]: ps.append(sr/k)
    return np.median(ps) if ps else 0
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    raw = S/"audio/tts_cache"/m.tts_key(l["text"], l["speaker"])
    out = W/f"line_{i+1:02d}_{l['speaker']}.wav"
    xr,sr=rd(raw); xo,so=rd(out)
    # trimmed versions
    tr=np.frombuffer(m.trim((np.clip(xo,-1,1)*32767).astype(np.int16).tobytes()),np.int16).astype(np.float32)/32768
    edge=lambda y,a,b: 20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(y[a:b]**2))+1e-9)
    e=int(.03*so)
    pk=20*np.log10(np.abs(xo).max()+1e-9)
    print(f"L{i+1} {l['speaker']:10s} raw {len(xr)/sr:5.2f}s out {len(xo)/so:5.2f}s ratio {len(xr)/sr/(len(xo)/so):.3f} "
          f"f0 raw {f0(xr,sr):5.0f} out {f0(xo,so):5.0f} | trimmed {len(tr)/so:5.2f}s first30ms {edge(tr,0,e):6.1f}dB last30ms {edge(tr,-e,None):6.1f}dB peak {pk:5.1f} raw_exists {raw.exists()}")
# voice.wav gaps
v,sr=rd(W/"voice.wav"); hop=int(.01*sr)
lev=20*np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(v[:len(v)//hop*hop].reshape(-1,hop)**2,1))+1e-9)
sil=lev<-50; runs=[]; s=None
for k,b in enumerate(sil):
    if b and s is None: s=k
    if not b and s is not None:
        if k-s>=5: runs.append((s/100,k/100))
        s=None
if s is not None: runs.append((s/100,len(sil)/100))
print("voice.wav", len(v)/sr, "silences>=50ms:", [(a,round(b-a,2)) for a,b in runs])
EOF
./.venv/Scripts/python -X utf8 -I $R/an.py 2>&1 | tail -15
```

```text
# ---------- 5. final-only checks ----------
def loudness_report(out: Path, work: Path, timed):
    """Final loudness + true peak, and music level the RULES way: integrated LUFS of the voice stem vs the music
    stem, both cut to the same speech sections (both stems are pre-loudnorm; loudnorm gain hits both equally)."""
    r = run([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-i", out, "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"])
    lufs = float(re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1])
    tp = float(re.findall(r"Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS", r.stderr)[-1])
    sel = "+".join(f"between(t,{l['start']:.2f},{l['end']:.2f})" for l in timed if l["speaker"] != "_pause")

    def speech_lufs(f):
        r = run([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-i", f, "-af", f"aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,"
                 f"aselect='{sel}',asetpts=N/SR/TB,ebur128", "-f", "null", "-"])
        return float(re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1])

    below = speech_lufs(work / "voice.wav") - speech_lufs(work / "music.wav")
    return lufs, tp, below

    cols = 6

    for i, im in enumerate(tiles):
        sheet.paste(im, ((i % cols) * 270, (i // cols) * im.height))
    sheet.save(path)
```

```text
def build_audio(voice, total, events, meta, work: Path, two_pass: bool, below_db: float):
    """Voice + music (one track, or a track per mood with crossfades) at a fixed level under the voice + stings;
    music muted in any music_silent window. Also writes music.wav (music stem) for the level check."""
    v_lufs = integrated_lufs(voice)
    segs = music_segments(events, meta, total)
    lufs_of = {}
    inputs = ["-i", voice]
    fc = [f"[0:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo[v]"]
    for k, (a, b, f) in enumerate(segs):
        if f not in lufs_of:
            lufs_of[f] = integrated_lufs(f, 60)
        gain = v_lufs - below_db - lufs_of[f]
        last = k == len(segs) - 1
        length = (b - a) + (0 if last else MUSIC_XFADE)  # overlap into the next mood = crossfade
        fade_out = f"afade=t=out:st={length - (1.5 if last else MUSIC_XFADE):.2f}:d={1.5 if last else MUSIC_XFADE}"
        fade_in = f"afade=t=in:d={MUSIC_XFADE}," if k else ""
        ms = int(a * 1000)
        off = music_offset(f, a, b, events.get("pauses", []))
        if off:
            print(f"  music: {Path(f).stem} starts {off:.2f}s in (pause falls on an audible part)")
        inputs += ["-stream_loop", "-1", *(["-ss", f"{off:.2f}"] if off else []), "-i", f]
```

```bash
def voicing(x,sr):
    n=int(.04*sr); hop=int(.02*sr); v=[]; jit=[]
    for i in range(0,len(x)-n,hop):
        f=x[i:i+n]-x[i:i+n].mean()
        if np.sqrt(np.mean(f**2))<0.03: continue
        c=np.correlate(f,f,'full')[n-1:]; lo,hi=int(sr/400),int(sr/70); k=lo+np.argmax(c[lo:hi]); v.append(c[k]/c[0])
    return np.mean(v)
def hf(x,sr):  # share of energy above 4 kHz (phasing/metallic artefacts push this around)
    X=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(x))**2; f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(x),1/sr); return 10*np.log10(X[f>4000].sum()/X.sum())
```

```text
60:60:## 9. Safety
61-61:- Never show or commit `.env`, `secrets/`, API keys or OAuth tokens.
62-62:- Never delete files; move them to `_to_delete/`.
63-63:- Paid source files (story images/, audio/, characters/) are read-only for every build. Builds write only to their own _work/ and output/ folders. After every build Munshi checks that no paid source file changed (git status / hash). Any change is a BLOCKER.
64-64:
65-65:## 10. Copyright (STRICT — any violation is FIX and blocks upload)
66-66:- Every external file used in any video (music, sound effect, font, image, footage, voice) must have a row in `shared/assets_license.csv`: path, source_url, author, license, attribution_text, date_added. No row = not allowed.
67-67:- Allowed licences only: CC0; CC BY 4.0 (with exact credit in the description); SIL OFL (fonts); YouTube Audio Library tracks (follow their attribution note); our own Gemini-generated images/voices; our own recordings.
68-68:- Never allowed: CC BY-NC (non-commercial, conflicts with monetization), CC BY-ND (we edit/mix), CC BY-SA, "free for personal use", Freesound "Sampling+", unknown source, anything ripped from YouTube/Spotify/Instagram/films/TV, Bollywood or any commercial song (even hummed or sung by TTS), Google/Pinterest images.
69-69:- Freesound: licence is per sound. Check each file's own licence page; only CC0 or CC BY 4.0.
70-70:- Content: no real brand logos, no film/TV/cartoon characters (Chhota Bheem, Motu Patlu, Disney, etc.), no celebrity likeness, no copied song lyrics, no copied text from modern books. Old folk tales (Panchatantra, Jataka, Akbar-Birbal) are public domain, but we always write our own version, never copy a modern retelling.
71-71:- Image prompts never name a studio, franchise or living artist ("Pixar style", "Ghibli style", etc.).
72-72:- Before upload, Munshi checks: every audio/image/font file in the final build is in the register, every CC BY item is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks, and no source audio from outside our pipeline is in the mix.
73-73:- After upload: if YouTube Studio shows any copyright claim or strike, stop all new uploads and tell the user. CC music sometimes gets false Content ID claims; dispute only with the licence proof from the register, after the user agrees.
74-74:
75:75:## 11. Review limits and severity
76-76:Every problem Munshi reports is marked BLOCKER or MINOR.
77-77:
78-78:BLOCKER (never waived, in any round):
79-79:- Copyright (section 10), wrong channel, any secret exposed.
80-80:- Wrong character on screen for a line, wrong voice for a character, a line missing or cut off.
81-81:- Caption more than 1 s away from its line, or caption text not matching what is spoken.
82-82:- Loudness outside -14 LUFS ±1, true peak above -1.0 dBFS, audible clipping or leaked outside audio.
83-83:- Wrong resolution/codec, or a preview file used as final.
84-84:- Thumbnail: broken Hindi matras, spoiler, unreadable text, important thing in the bottom-right corner.
85-85:- Metadata: title over 100 chars, more than 15 hashtags, missing CC BY credit, "for kids" wording (title, thumbnail, description or tags), mystery answer revealed.
86-86:- Length outside ±10% of the approved preview length.
87-87:- Story problem: moral missing or a scene that contradicts the script.
88-88:
89-89:MINOR (everything else that breaks a RULES limit only slightly), e.g.: caption off by 0.3–1 s, caption shorter than 0.4 s, music level within 3 dB of target, thumbnail text slightly under the size rule, small silent gaps, missing colour tags, tiny cosmetic issues.
90-90:Taste points (pacing feel, colour choice, music phrase) are "Note" only and never count as problems.
91-91:
92-92:Rounds:
93-93:- Round 1 (R1): full review for that stage; BLOCKER and MINOR both come back as FIX (free) or ASK (paid).
94-94:- Round 2 (R2): re-check only what changed and what failed in R1.
95-95:- After R2: if any BLOCKER remains → ASK the user, stop. If only MINOR remain → verdict "PASS-WITH-NOTES": the stage is passed and the pipeline moves on to the next step (including upload when the user has approved it). No third round.
96-96:- Every MINOR waived after R2 is written to channels/<key>/carry_over.md (project, issue, suggested fix). Before the next video's build, the builder reads carry_over.md and fixes those causes in the pipeline, then marks them done.
97-97:
98-98:These limits never weaken: copyright (section 10), channel ID check, secrets, and the full pre-upload check.
99-99:At the end of each review, add one line to channels/<key>/log.md with the round (R1/R2), verdict and approximate time taken.
```

```text
def run(args, cwd=None):
    r = subprocess.run([str(a) for a in args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f"FAILED: {' '.join(map(str, args))[:300]}\n{r.stderr[-2000:]}")
    return r


PROTECTED: list[Path] = []  # paid source folders of the current build (set in main): read-only for every build
_new_tts: set[Path] = set()


def guard_write(path, new_tts=False):
    """Stop the build before it writes into a paid source folder (story/channel images, audio, characters).
    Only exception: a brand-new TTS cache file (paid call allowed with --spend); existing files are never overwritten."""
    rp = Path(path).resolve()
    if any(rp.is_relative_to(d) for d in PROTECTED):
        if new_tts and not rp.exists():
            _new_tts.add(rp)
            return
        sys.exit(f"STOP (BLOCKER): build tried to write a paid source file: {rp.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}. "
                 "Builds may write only to their own _work/ and output/ folders.")


def snapshot(dirs):
    """{file: (size, mtime_ns)} of every file in the paid source folders."""
    return {f: (f.stat().st_size, f.stat().st_mtime_ns) for d in dirs if d.exists() for f in d.rglob("*") if f.is_file()}


def check_snapshot(before, dirs):
    after = snapshot(dirs)
    changed = [f for f in before if after.get(f) != before[f]]
    added = [f for f in after if f not in before and f.resolve() not in _new_tts]
    if changed or added:
        bad = ", ".join(f.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for f in changed + added)
        sys.exit(f"STOP (BLOCKER): paid source files changed during the build: {bad}")
    return len(after)


def sha(*parts) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    for p in parts:
        h.update(p if isinstance(p, bytes) else str(p).encode("utf-8"))
    return h.hexdigest()[:16]


# ---------- 1. voice ----------
def tts_key(text, speaker):
    voice, style, _ = CAST[speaker]
    return f"{speaker}_{sha(gemini_tts.MODEL, '|', voice, '|', style, '|', text)}.wav"


def check_tts_spend(lines, cache: Path, allow: bool):
    """Paid TTS only on cache miss, and only with --spend. Otherwise stop and show the estimate."""
    misses = [l for l in lines if "text" in l and not (cache / tts_key(l["text"], l["speaker"])).exists()]
    if not misses:
        return
    secs = sum(len(l["text"].split()) / 2.4 for l in misses)  # ~2.4 words/s
    usd = secs * gemini_tts.AUDIO_TOKENS_PER_SEC * gemini_tts.PRICE_OUT / 1e6
    print(f"  {len(misses)} TTS line(s) not cached: " + ", ".join(l["speaker"] for l in misses)
          + f"  -> ~₹{usd * cost_log.USD_TO_INR:.2f}")
    if not allow:
        sys.exit("  Paid TTS needed. Re-run with --spend to allow it.")


def tts_line(text, speaker, cache: Path, out: Path, extra_af=None, chorus=False) -> bytes:
    """Cached Gemini TTS + optional pitch shift / extra filter (e.g. echo) / chorus (3 detuned, offset copies
    so one voice sounds like a group). Returns PCM s16 mono."""
    raw = cache / tts_key(text, speaker)
    guard_write(out)
    if not raw.exists():
        guard_write(raw, new_tts=True)
        voice, style, _ = CAST[speaker]
        res = gemini_tts.speak(text, voice, style, raw)
        print(f"    new TTS {speaker}: ₹{res['row']['cost_inr']} (aaj ₹{res['row']['today_total_inr']}, "
              f"bacha ₹{res['row']['remaining_inr']})")
    chain = ",".join(f for f in (pitch_filter(CAST[speaker][2], SR), extra_af) if f) or "anull"
    if chorus:
        fc = (f"[0:a]{chain},asplit=3[a][b][c];[b]{pitch_filter(2, SR)},adelay=45[b2];"
              f"[c]{pitch_filter(-2, SR)},adelay=90[c2];[a][b2][c2]amix=inputs=3:normalize=0,volume=0.6[o]")
        args = ["-filter_complex", fc, "-map", "[o]"]
    else:
        args = ["-af", chain]
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", raw, *args, "-ac", "1", "-ar", SR, "-sample_fmt", "s16", out])
    with wave.open(str(out)) as w:
        return w.readframes(w.getnframes())


def trim(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Trim lead/tail silence by energy so the line's voice starts at its first sample."""
    x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
    hop = int(0.01 * SR)
    lev = 20 * np.log10(np.sqrt(np.mean(x[: len(x) // hop * hop].reshape(-1, hop) ** 2, axis=1)) + 1e-9)
    voiced = np.where(lev > lev.max() - 35)[0]
    s0 = max(0, voiced[0] * hop - int(0.01 * SR))
    e0 = min(len(x), (voiced[-1] + 1) * hop + int(TAIL * SR))
    return data[s0 * 2:e0 * 2]


_whisper = None


def _clean_len(s):
    return len(re.sub(r"[^\u0900-\u097F\w]", "", s))


def word_times(data: bytes, text: str, cache: Path, run_whisper: bool, words_dir: Path | None = None):
    """Script tokens timed by Whisper word timestamps (cached per audio). Whisper's spelling may differ from the
    script, so timings are mapped through character position. Without a cached result, Whisper only runs when
    run_whisper (final); otherwise timings are proportional to word length."""
    global _whisper
    tokens = text.split()
    dur = len(data) / 2 / SR
    name = f"words_{sha(data)}.json"
    key = cache / name  # older builds kept Whisper results next to the TTS; read them, never write there again
    if not key.exists() and words_dir:
        key = words_dir / name
    ww, note = [], None
    if key.exists():
        ww = json.loads(key.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    elif run_whisper:
        if _whisper is None:
            from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
            _whisper = WhisperModel("small", device="cpu", compute_type="int8",
                                    download_root=str(ROOT / "tools" / "whisper-models"))
        x = np.frombuffer(data, np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768
        x16 = np.interp(np.arange(0, len(x), SR / 16000), np.arange(len(x)), x).astype(np.float32)
        # no initial_prompt: with the script as prompt Whisper sometimes skips words it thinks were already said
        segs, _ = _whisper.transcribe(x16, language="hi", word_timestamps=True, beam_size=5)
        ww = [(w.start, w.end, w.word.strip()) for s in segs for w in (s.words or []) if _clean_len(w.word)]
        guard_write(key)
        key.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        key.write_text(json.dumps(ww, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        note = "proportional (Whisper runs on --final)"
    # only trust Whisper if it heard roughly the whole line (it can drop words)
    coverage = sum(_clean_len(w) for _, _, w in ww) / max(1, sum(_clean_len(t) for t in tokens))
    if ww and not 0.75 <= coverage <= 1.35:
        ww, note = [], f"PROPORTIONAL (whisper coverage {coverage:.0%})"
    if ww:
        lens = [_clean_len(w) for _, _, w in ww]
        tot, acc, xs, ts = sum(lens), 0, [], []
        for (a, b, _), n in zip(ww, lens):
            xs += [acc / tot, (acc + n) / tot]
            ts += [a, b]
            acc += n
        xs[0], xs[-1] = 0.0, 1.0
        note = f"whisper {coverage:.0%}"
    else:
        xs, ts = [0.0, 1.0], [0.0, dur]
    lens = [_clean_len(t) + 1 for t in tokens]
    tot, acc, words = sum(lens), 0, []
    for tok, n in zip(tokens, lens):
        words.append((float(np.interp(acc / tot, xs, ts)), float(np.interp((acc + n) / tot, xs, ts)), tok))
        acc += n
    return words, note


def build_voice(lines, audio_dir: Path, work: Path, run_whisper: bool, end_hold: float = END_HOLD,
                gap_s: float = GAP, speed: float = 1.0, gap_change: float | None = None):
    """speed: tempo factor for every spoken line (atempo keeps the pitch; cached TTS reused, no new cost).
    gap_s: silence between two lines of the same speaker; gap_change: when the speaker changes (default = gap_s).
    meta.json "speed" / "gap" / "gap_speaker_change" let a Short run tighter than the long video."""
    pcm, t = bytearray(), 0.0
    GAP = gap_s  # noqa: N806 - local override of the module default
    gap_change = GAP if gap_change is None else gap_change
    prev_speaker = None
    silence = lambda sec: b"\x00\x00" * int(round(sec * SR))
    timed, events = [], {"sfx": [], "music_silent": [], "moods": []}
    cache = audio_dir / "tts_cache"
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if "pause" in line:  # music-only beat with its own picture
            gap = GAP if i else 0.0
            pcm += silence(gap + line["pause"])
            start, t = t + gap, t + gap + line["pause"]
            if line.get("mood"):
                events["moods"].append((start, line["mood"]))
            if line.get("sfx"):
                events["sfx"].append((start + 0.05, line["sfx"]))
            timed.append({**line, "speaker": "_pause", "text": "", "start": start, "end": t,
                          "audio_hash": f"pause{line['pause']}", "words": []})
            events.setdefault("pauses", []).append((start - PAUSE_LEAD, t))
            print(f"  line {i + 1:2d} [{'pause':8s}] {start:6.2f}-{t:6.2f}s  music only")
            continue
        tempo = f"atempo={speed}" if speed != 1.0 else None
        data = trim(tts_line(line["text"], line["speaker"], cache,
                             work / f"line_{i + 1:02d}_{line['speaker']}.wav",  # per video, not the shared story audio/
                             extra_af=",".join(f for f in (line.get("af"), tempo) if f) or None,
                             chorus=line.get("chorus", False)))
        words, note = word_times(data, line["text"], cache, run_whisper, words_dir=work / "words")
        gap = 0.0
        if i:
            base = GAP if line["speaker"] == prev_speaker else gap_change
            gap = base + line.get("pause_before", 0)
            if line.get("music_silent_before"):
                events["music_silent"].append((t + base / 2, t + gap))
            pcm += silence(gap)
            t += gap
        start = t
        prev_speaker = line["speaker"]
        if line.get("mood"):
            events["moods"].append((start - gap, line["mood"]))
        pcm += data
        t += len(data) / 2 / SR
        timed.append({**line, "start": start, "end": t, "audio_hash": sha(data),
                      "words": [(start + a, start + b, w) for a, b, w in words]})
        if line.get("sfx_after"):
            events["sfx"].append((t + 0.05, line["sfx_after"]))
        print(f"  line {i + 1:2d} [{line['speaker']:8s}] {start:6.2f}-{t:6.2f}s  {note}")
    pcm += silence(end_hold)
    total = len(pcm) / 2 / SR
    voice = work / "voice.wav"
    with wave.open(str(voice), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1), w.setsampwidth(2), w.setframerate(SR), w.writeframes(bytes(pcm))
    return voice, total, timed, events


# ---------- 2. captions ----------
def ass_time(s):
    cs = max(0, int(round(s * 100)))
    return f"{cs // 360000}:{cs // 6000 % 60:02d}:{cs // 100 % 60:02d}.{cs % 100:02d}"


def caption_chunks(line):
    """[(start, end, text)] in global seconds, 2-3 words each, never past the line's audio.
    An optional "caption" in lines.json changes only the on-screen text (no new TTS); its words are timed
    through character position on the spoken words' timeline."""

# ---------- 5. final-only checks ----------
def loudness_report(out: Path, work: Path, timed):
    """Final loudness + true peak, and music level the RULES way: integrated LUFS of the voice stem vs the music
    stem, both cut to the same speech sections (both stems are pre-loudnorm; loudnorm gain hits both equally)."""
    r = run([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-i", out, "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"])
    lufs = float(re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1])
    tp = float(re.findall(r"Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS", r.stderr)[-1])
    sel = "+".join(f"between(t,{l['start']:.2f},{l['end']:.2f})" for l in timed if l["speaker"] != "_pause")

    def speech_lufs(f):
        r = run([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-i", f, "-af", f"aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,"
                 f"aselect='{sel}',asetpts=N/SR/TB,ebur128", "-f", "null", "-"])
        return float(re.findall(r"I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS", r.stderr)[-1])

    below = speech_lufs(work / "voice.wav") - speech_lufs(work / "music.wav")
    return lufs, tp, below


def frame_check(out: Path, timed, path: Path, work: Path):
    """One frame from the middle of every line, labelled with time + speaker, tiled into one image."""
    tiles = []
    font = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 22) if Path("C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf").exists() else ImageFont.load_default()
    for i, l in enumerate(timed):
        t = (l["start"] + l["end"]) / 2
        f = work / f"check_{i:02d}.png"
        run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-ss", f"{t:.2f}", "-i", out, "-frames:v", 1, "-vf", "scale=270:-2", f])
        im = Image.open(f).convert("RGB")
        ImageDraw.Draw(im).rectangle((0, 0, 270, 30), fill=(0, 0, 0))
        ImageDraw.Draw(im).text((6, 4), f"{t:5.1f}s {l['speaker']}", fill=(255, 230, 0), font=font)
        tiles.append(im)
    cols = 6
    rows = (len(tiles) + cols - 1) // cols
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * 270, rows * tiles[0].height))
    for i, im in enumerate(tiles):
        sheet.paste(im, ((i % cols) * 270, (i // cols) * im.height))
    sheet.save(path)


def srt_time(s):
    ms = max(0, int(round(s * 1000)))
    return f"{ms // 3600000:02d}:{ms // 60000 % 60:02d}:{ms // 1000 % 60:02d},{ms % 1000:03d}"


def write_srt(timed, path: Path):
    """Captions file for upload (long videos don't burn captions into the picture)."""
    cues = [c for l in timed if l["words"] for c in caption_chunks(l)]
    path.write_text("\n".join(f"{i}\n{srt_time(a)} --> {srt_time(b)}\n{txt}\n" for i, (a, b, txt) in
                              enumerate(cues, 1)), encoding="utf-8")


def register_row(f: Path):
    """The asset's row in shared/assets_license.csv (RULES section 10). No row -> stop the build."""
    rows = {r["path"]: r for r in csv.DictReader(REGISTER.open(encoding="utf-8", newline=""))}
    rel = Path(f).resolve().relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    if rel not in rows:
        sys.exit(f"STOP: {rel} is not in {REGISTER.name} (RULES section 10). Verify its licence and add a row first.")
    return rows[rel]


def check_register(meta):
    g.add_argument("--final", action="store_true", help="1080x1920 upload build + checks")

    except KeyError as e:

    if missing:

    check_register(meta)
    if a.plan:
        plan_report(P, lines, meta)
        return
    chan = ROOT / "channels" / P["channel"]
    PROTECTED[:] = [d.resolve() for d in (P["story"] / "images", P["story"] / "audio", P["story"] / "characters",
                                          chan / "characters")]
    paid_before = snapshot(PROTECTED)

    out_dir = P["out_dir"]
    work = out_dir / f"{case}_work"
    audio_dir = P["audio_dir"]
    cache_dir = P["cache_dir"]

        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy(FONT, work / "fonts" / FONT.name)

    print(f"[{P['kind'].upper()} {mode.upper()}] {prof['w']}x{prof['h']} @ {prof['fps']} fps")
    print("1/4 voice")

    voice, total, timed, events = build_voice(lines, audio_dir, work, run_whisper=(mode == "final"),
                                              end_hold=meta.get("end_hold", END_HOLD), gap_s=meta.get("gap", GAP),
                                              speed=meta.get("speed", 1.0), gap_change=meta.get("gap_speaker_change"))
    if a.seconds:  # test render: keep the lines that start inside the first N seconds
        total = min(total, a.seconds)
        timed = [l for l in timed if l["start"] < total]
        events = {k: [e for e in v if e[0] < total] for k, v in events.items()}  # music/sfx cues after the cut go too
        case = f"{case}_test{a.seconds:g}s"
    warn = P["kind"] == "short" and not a.seconds and not 45 <= total <= 60
    print(f"  total {total:.1f}s" + ("  WARNING: outside 45-60s" if warn else ""))

    print("2/4 scenes")
    plans = plan_scenes(P, timed, total, prof, font_family, meta.get("final_title", "बताओ, दोषी कौन?"),
                        meta.get("final_title_secs"))
    cached, new = build_video(plans, prof, cache_dir, work)

    print("3/4 audio")
    norm = build_audio(voice, total, events, meta, work, two_pass=(mode == "final"),
                       below_db=MUSIC_BELOW_VOICE_DB[P["kind"]])

    print("4/4 mux (video stream copied, no re-encode)")
    out = out_dir / (f"{case}.mp4" if mode == "final" else f"{case}_preview.mp4")
    run([FFMPEG, "-y", "-i", "video.mp4", "-i", norm, "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-ar", 48000,
         "-shortest", "-movflags", "+faststart", out], cwd=work)
    report = ""
    if not P["burn"] and not a.seconds:
        srt = out.with_suffix(".srt")
        write_srt(timed, srt)
        report += f"\n  captions:    {srt}"

    if mode == "final":
        lufs, tp, below = loudness_report(out, work, timed)
        check = out_dir / f"{case}_framecheck.png"
        frame_check(out, timed, check, work)
        txt = out_dir / f"{case}.txt"
        tags = f"TAGS:\n{', '.join(meta['tags'])}\n\n" if meta.get("tags") else ""
        txt.write_text(
            f"TITLE:\n{meta['title']}\n\nDESCRIPTION:\n{meta['description']}\n\n"
            f"{music_credits(meta, events, total)}\n\n{' '.join(meta['hashtags'])}\n\n{tags}"
            f"PINNED COMMENT (post later):\n{meta['pinned_comment']}\n", encoding="utf-8")
        report += (f"\n  loudness {lufs:.1f} LUFS, true peak {tp:.1f} dBFS, music {below:.1f} LU under voice "
                   f"(stem LUFS over speech)"
                   f"\n  frame check: {check}\n  metadata:    {txt}")

    n_paid = check_snapshot(paid_before, PROTECTED)
    report += (f"\n  paid source files unchanged: {n_paid} files checked"
               + (f" (+{len(_new_tts)} new TTS)" if _new_tts else ""))
    spent = sum(float(r["cost_inr"]) for r in cost_log._rows()) - spend_before
    print(f"\nDONE [{mode}] {out}  ({total:.1f}s video)"
          f"\n  scenes: {cached} cache se, {new} naye   |   build time {time.perf_counter() - t_start:.0f}s"
          f"   |   is build ka kharcha ₹{spent:.2f}{report}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```text
1	# Munshi RULES — Story-Channel
2	
3	Shared rules for every channel. Munshi reads this file first, then `channels/<key>/RULES.md`.
4	- Channel RULES can be stricter than shared RULES, never looser. Copyright, channel ID, secrets and upload safety can never be relaxed by a channel.

6	
7	These are the hard rules. If a builder summary, a script or a file disagrees with them, the rule wins and the step is not PASS. Edit this file to add new rules; Munshi reads it fresh every time.
8	- A measured value outside a RULES limit is always FIX, never PASS, even if small. (in R1; after R2 see section 11)
9	
10	## 1. Budget
11	- Prepaid Google Cloud budget: ₹500, auto-reload off. Current balance is whatever `cost_log.csv` says.
12	- Every paid call (Gemini image ≈ ₹3.24 each at 1K, Gemini TTS per line) must be in `cost_log.csv` with date, project, item, ₹.
13	- No paid call without the user's OK first. A fix that costs money is always ASK, never FIX.
14	- Flag it if a step cost more than 30% above its estimate (e.g. LONG_01 TTS: estimate ₹4.85, actual ₹6.63).
15	
16	## 2. Story and characters (from `channel_bible.md`)
17	- Characters must match their approved sheets: face, clothes, colours, age look. Compare each scene image against the sheet with Read.
18	- The action in each image must match what the line says at that moment (who is holding what, who is talking).
19	
20	## 3. Audio
21	- Final loudness: -14 LUFS integrated (±1), true peak ≤ -1.0 dBFS.
22	- Music sits under the voice: 12–14 dB below for Shorts, up to ~18–20 dB for narration-heavy long videos. If it is quieter than 20 dB under, flag it.
23	- Music level is measured one way only: integrated LUFS of the voice-only stem vs the music-only stem over the same speech sections. Builder and Munshi both use this method.
24	- Mood changes get a crossfade (≥1 s). No sudden music cuts under dialogue.
25	- No leaked background audio, clicks, or a line cut off mid-word.
26	
27	## 4. Captions
28	- One `.srt` per video, Hindi, UTF-8.
29	- Each caption must appear while that line is being spoken (±0.3 s), over the right character's shot.
30	- Lines whose timing was estimated rather than taken from Whisper must be listed in the report.
31	
32	## 5. Video
33	- Long video: 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264, 16:9. Short: 1080×1920, ≤60 s, 9:16.
34	- Target length: the duration the user approved at preview. Before preview, the script estimate is only a guide. Final must be within ±10% of the approved preview length; outside that is ASK.
35	- Preview builds (960×540) are only for review. They are never uploaded.
36	
37	## 6. Thumbnail
38	- 1280×720, JPG or PNG, ≤ 2 MB.
39	- Hindi text is rendered by libass/FFmpeg (HarfBuzz shaping), never drawn by the AI. Zoom in and check matras and joined letters (ड़, दु, क्ष, etc.).
40	- Text readable on a phone: letter height ≥ ~12% of frame height, high contrast, max ~4 words.
41	- Thumbnail text must not repeat the title word for word.
42	- No spoilers: no ending, no twist, no mystery answer.
43	- Bottom-right corner (~15% × 12%) has nothing important, because YouTube puts the duration there.
44	
45	## 7. Metadata
46	- Title ≤ 100 characters, no `<` or `>`. Description ≤ 5000 characters.
47	- Tags total ≤ 500 characters. 3–5 hashtags in the description (the first 3 show above the title; more than 15 and YouTube ignores all of them).
48	- Every CC BY music track used (e.g. Incompetech / Kevin MacLeod) is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks.
49	- Made-for-kids and AI-disclosure values come from `channels/<key>/channel.json`. Never guess them.
50	
51	## 8. Publishing
52	- Publish slot: the same day as the upload, between 19:00 and 23:59 IST.
53	  - Upload finished before 18:45 IST -> publish at 19:00 the same day.
54	  - Upload finished between 18:45 and 23:15 IST -> publish at the next :00 or :30 that is at least 30 minutes after the upload.
55	  - Upload finished after 23:15 IST -> publish at 19:00 the next day.
56	- At most one long video per day per channel. If a long video is already scheduled that day, use 19:00 the next day. A Short may share a day with a long video only if their publish times are at least 2 hours apart, still inside 19:00-23:59.
57	- Nothing goes Public or gets scheduled without the user's OK in that conversation.
58	- One upload per video. If `output/upload_result.json` exists, do not upload again.
59	
60	## 9. Safety
61	- Never show or commit `.env`, `secrets/`, API keys or OAuth tokens.
62	- Never delete files; move them to `_to_delete/`.
63	- Paid source files (story images/, audio/, characters/) are read-only for every build. Builds write only to their own _work/ and output/ folders. After every build Munshi checks that no paid source file changed (git status / hash). Any change is a BLOCKER.
64	
65	## 10. Copyright (STRICT — any violation is FIX and blocks upload)
66	- Every external file used in any video (music, sound effect, font, image, footage, voice) must have a row in `shared/assets_license.csv`: path, source_url, author, license, attribution_text, date_added. No row = not allowed.
67	- Allowed licences only: CC0; CC BY 4.0 (with exact credit in the description); SIL OFL (fonts); YouTube Audio Library tracks (follow their attribution note); our own Gemini-generated images/voices; our own recordings.
68	- Never allowed: CC BY-NC (non-commercial, conflicts with monetization), CC BY-ND (we edit/mix), CC BY-SA, "free for personal use", Freesound "Sampling+", unknown source, anything ripped from YouTube/Spotify/Instagram/films/TV, Bollywood or any commercial song (even hummed or sung by TTS), Google/Pinterest images.
69	- Freesound: licence is per sound. Check each file's own licence page; only CC0 or CC BY 4.0.
70	- Content: no real brand logos, no film/TV/cartoon characters (Chhota Bheem, Motu Patlu, Disney, etc.), no celebrity likeness, no copied song lyrics, no copied text from modern books. Old folk tales (Panchatantra, Jataka, Akbar-Birbal) are public domain, but we always write our own version, never copy a modern retelling.
71	- Image prompts never name a studio, franchise or living artist ("Pixar style", "Ghibli style", etc.).
72	- Before upload, Munshi checks: every audio/image/font file in the final build is in the register, every CC BY item is credited in the description exactly as its licence asks, and no source audio from outside our pipeline is in the mix.
73	- After upload: if YouTube Studio shows any copyright claim or strike, stop all new uploads and tell the user. CC music sometimes gets false Content ID claims; dispute only with the licence proof from the register, after the user agrees.
74	
75	## 11. Review limits and severity
76	Every problem Munshi reports is marked BLOCKER or MINOR.
77	
78	BLOCKER (never waived, in any round):
79	- Copyright (section 10), wrong channel, any secret exposed.
80	- Wrong character on screen for a line, wrong voice for a character, a line missing or cut off.
81	- Caption more than 1 s away from its line, or caption text not matching what is spoken.
82	- Loudness outside -14 LUFS ±1, true peak above -1.0 dBFS, audible clipping or leaked outside audio.
83	- Wrong resolution/codec, or a preview file used as final.
84	- Thumbnail: broken Hindi matras, spoiler, unreadable text, important thing in the bottom-right corner.
85	- Metadata: title over 100 chars, more than 15 hashtags, missing CC BY credit, "for kids" wording (title, thumbnail, description or tags), mystery answer revealed.
86	- Length outside ±10% of the approved preview length.
87	- Story problem: moral missing or a scene that contradicts the script.
88	
89	MINOR (everything else that breaks a RULES limit only slightly), e.g.: caption off by 0.3–1 s, caption shorter than 0.4 s, music level within 3 dB of target, thumbnail text slightly under the size rule, small silent gaps, missing colour tags, tiny cosmetic issues.
90	Taste points (pacing feel, colour choice, music phrase) are "Note" only and never count as problems.
91	
92	Rounds:
93	- Round 1 (R1): full review for that stage; BLOCKER and MINOR both come back as FIX (free) or ASK (paid).
94	- Round 2 (R2): re-check only what changed and what failed in R1.
95	- After R2: if any BLOCKER remains → ASK the user, stop. If only MINOR remain → verdict "PASS-WITH-NOTES": the stage is passed and the pipeline moves on to the next step (including upload when the user has approved it). No third round.
96	- Every MINOR waived after R2 is written to channels/<key>/carry_over.md (project, issue, suggested fix). Before the next video's build, the builder reads carry_over.md and fixes those causes in the pipeline, then marks them done.
97	
98	These limits never weaken: copyright (section 10), channel ID check, secrets, and the full pre-upload check.
99	At the end of each review, add one line to channels/<key>/log.md with the round (R1/R2), verdict and approximate time taken.
```

Mix residual and music crossfade envelope

```bash
cd "D:/Story-Channel/channels/dadi-ki-kahaniyan/stories/001_lalchi-halwai/shorts/short_01_jadui-kadhai/output/short_01_jadui-kadhai_work" && D:/Story-Channel/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -I -c "
import wave,numpy as np
def rd(p):
  w=wave.open(p);sr=w.getframerate();ch=w.getnchannels();sw=w.getsampwidth();x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype={2:np.int16,4:np.int32}[sw]).astype(float)/(2**(8*sw-1))
  return sr,x.reshape(-1,ch)
for p in ['voice.wav','music.wav','mix.wav']:
  sr,x=rd(p);print(p,sr,x.shape)
sv,v=rd('voice.wav');sm,m=rd('music.wav');sx,mx=rd('mix.wav')
n=min(len(m),len(mx));
vv=v.mean(1);
if sv!=sx: vv=np.interp(np.arange(n)/sx,np.arange(len(vv))/sv,vv)
r=mx[:n].mean(1)-m[:n].mean(1)-vv[:n]
blk=int(0.1*sx)
for i in range(0,n-blk,blk):
  db=20*np.log10(np.sqrt((r[i:i+blk]**2).mean())+1e-12)
  if db>-60: print(f'{i/sx:.1f}s residual {db:.0f} dB')
print('floor',20*np.log10(np.sqrt((r**2).mean())+1e-12))
mm=m.mean(1)
print(' '.join(f'{t:.1f}:{20*np.log10(np.sqrt((mm[int(t*sm):int((t+0.25)*sm)]**2).mean())+1e-12):.0f}' for t in np.arange(16.5,22,0.25)))
"
```

```bash
import struct,sys
def dur(p):
    d=open(p,'rb').read()
    i=d.find(b'mvhd'); v=d[i+4]
    if v==1: ts,du=struct.unpack('>IQ',d[i+24:i+36])
    else: ts,du=struct.unpack('>II',d[i+16:i+24])
    return du/ts
for p in sys.argv[1:]: print(round(dur(p),3),p[-40:])
EOF
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Post the Short -> Long first comment once the Short is public (RULES section 8, Short -> Long link).

Usage:
    python tools/post_comment.py --job <short video folder>/output/upload.json --dry-run
    python tools/post_comment.py --job <short video folder>/output/upload.json      (run by the scheduled task)

Runs from the Windows scheduled task StoryChannel-Comment-<video_id> that youtube_upload.py creates for
publish_at + 5 min. Checks the logged-in channel, waits while the video is not public yet (15 min, max 6 tries),
posts "पूरी कहानी यहाँ देखें 👉 <long URL>", writes comment_id to upload_result.json, logs to shared/sync.log and
removes its own scheduled task. Never prints tokens.
"""
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

try:
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
except Exception:
    pass

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SYNC_LOG = ROOT / "shared" / "sync.log"
CTA = "पूरी कहानी यहाँ देखें 👉 https://youtu.be/{id}"
TASK_PREFIX = "StoryChannel-Comment-"


def comment_text(parent_id: str) -> str:
    return CTA.format(id=parent_id)


def log(msg: str):
    line = f"{dt.datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}  {msg}"
    SYNC_LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with SYNC_LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")
    print(line)


def task_name(video_id: str) -> str:
    return TASK_PREFIX + video_id


def _ps(cmd: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    return subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", cmd],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)


def schedule_task(job_path: Path, video_id: str, when: dt.datetime) -> str:
    """Windows scheduled task that runs this script once at `when` (timezone-aware)."""
    name = task_name(video_id)
    at = when.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)  # local wall-clock time for the task scheduler
    args = f'-X utf8 "{Path(__file__).resolve()}" --job "{Path(job_path).resolve()}"'
    cmd = (f"$a = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute '{sys.executable}' -Argument '{args}' -WorkingDirectory '{ROOT}'; "
           f"$t = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Once -At ([datetime]'{at:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S}'); "
           f"$s = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -StartWhenAvailable; "
           f"Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName '{name}' -Action $a -Trigger $t -Settings $s -Force | Out-Null")
    r = _ps(cmd)
    if r.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"could not create task {name}: {r.stderr.strip()[:300]}")
    return name


def task_exists(name: str) -> bool:
    return _ps(f"if (Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName '{name}' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {{ exit 0 }} else {{ exit 1 }}"
               ).returncode == 0


def remove_task(name: str):
    _ps(f"Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName '{name}' -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--job", required=True, help="the Short's upload.json")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="show what would happen; no network, no comment")
    ap.add_argument("--attempts", type=int, default=6)
    ap.add_argument("--wait-min", type=float, default=15)
    a = ap.parse_args()

    job_path = Path(a.job).resolve()
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result_path = job_path.parent / "upload_result.json"
    result = json.loads(result_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if result_path.exists() else {}
    vid, parent = result.get("video_id"), job.get("parent_video_id")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
    import youtube_upload as yu  # noqa: E402

    if not parent:
        sys.exit("job has no parent_video_id: nothing to post")
    text = comment_text(parent)
    if a.dry_run:
        print("DRY RUN (no network, no comment)")
        print("Channel:   ", job.get("channel_name"), job.get("channel_id"))
        print("Short id:  ", vid or "<not uploaded yet>")
        print("Comment:   ", text)
        print("Token file:", yu.token_path(job).name, "present" if yu.token_path(job).exists() else "MISSING")
        print("Task name: ", task_name(vid or "<video_id>"))
        print(f"Plan: check channel; if video not public, retry every {a.wait_min:g} min up to {a.attempts} times; "
              "post; save comment_id; remove the task; log to shared/sync.log")
        return

    if not vid:
        sys.exit("no video_id in upload_result.json")
    if result.get("comment_id"):
        log(f"comment: already posted on {vid} ({result['comment_id']}), nothing to do")
        remove_task(task_name(vid))
        return
    if not yu.token_path(job).exists():  # never open a browser from a scheduled task
        log(f"ERROR: comment for {vid}: no YouTube token ({yu.token_path(job).name}); log in once, then run again")
        sys.exit(1)

    yt = yu.get_service(job)
    yu.check_channel(yt, job)
    for attempt in range(1, a.attempts + 1):
        items = yt.videos().list(part="status", id=vid).execute().get("items", [])
        status = items[0]["status"]["privacyStatus"] if items else "missing"
        if status == "public":
            resp = yt.commentThreads().insert(part="snippet", body={"snippet": {
                "videoId": vid, "topLevelComment": {"snippet": {"textOriginal": text}}}}).execute()
            result["comment_id"] = resp["id"]
            result["comment_posted_at"] = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
            result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            log(f"comment: posted on {vid} (comment {resp['id']}) -> pin it in Studio")
            remove_task(task_name(vid))
            return
        if attempt < a.attempts:
            log(f"comment: {vid} is {status}, retry in {a.wait_min:g} min ({attempt}/{a.attempts})")
            time.sleep(a.wait_min * 60)
    log(f"ERROR: comment for {vid} not posted: video still {status} after {a.attempts} tries "
        f"(set it Public/Scheduled in Studio, then run tools/post_comment.py --job {job_path.relative_to(ROOT)})")
    sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```text
---
name: youtube-publish
description: Upload and schedule an approved Story-Channel video to YouTube with tools/youtube_upload.py, including one-time OAuth setup. Used by the munshi agent after the user approves the final build.
---

# Publish a video to YouTube

Uses `tools/youtube_upload.py` (YouTube Data API v3). Never upload without the user's explicit OK in this conversation.

## One-time setup (guide the user, they do the clicks in Google Cloud Console)
1. Use the same Google Cloud project as Gemini, or a new one. Enable **YouTube Data API v3**.
2. OAuth consent screen: User type External. Add the channel's Google account as a test user. Then **Publish app** (move it to In production). If it stays in Testing, the refresh token expires every 7 days and uploads stop working.
3. Credentials: Create OAuth client ID, type **Desktop app**. Download JSON and save it as `secrets/client_secret.json`. Make sure `secrets/` is in `.gitignore`.
4. `pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-oauthlib`
5. First real run opens a browser: pick the right Google account AND the right channel, accept the "unverified app" warning (it is the user's own app). Token is saved to `secrets/youtube_token_<channel_key>.json`; later runs are silent.
6. Phone-verify the channel in YouTube Studio, otherwise custom thumbnails fail.

## Important limit: unaudited API projects
Videos uploaded through the API from a project that has not passed YouTube's API audit are locked to **private**, and scheduling may not take effect. Until the audit is approved:
- Upload as private (the script does this when `publish_at` is set).
- Tell the user the one Studio step left: open the studio_url and set Schedule / Public.
- Suggest applying for the audit (YouTube API Services audit and quota extension form, free, takes a few weeks). After approval, scheduling becomes fully automatic.
Quota: default 10,000 units/day; one upload costs about 1,600, thumbnail 50, captions 400. Check the current numbers in the docs if uploads fail with quotaExceeded.

## Per-video steps
1. Confirm in `channels/<key>/log.md`: PASS for final build, thumbnail and metadata of this project. Confirm `output/upload_result.json` does not exist.
2. Read `channels/<key>/channel.json` for made_for_kids, contains_synthetic_media, category_id, language, publish time, playlist id. If made_for_kids is null, ASK the user and save the answer there.
3. Pick publish time per RULES section 8, inside `publish_window_ist` (19:00-23:59 IST), the same day as the upload:
   - upload expected to finish before 18:45 IST -> 19:00 the same day;
   - finishing 18:45-23:15 IST -> the next :00 or :30 at least 30 minutes after the upload finishes;
   - after 23:15 IST -> 19:00 the next day.
   Then check clashes: read every other project's `output/upload_result.json` (`publish_at`) and its `upload.json` (`format`).
   At most `max_long_per_day` long video per day: if a long one is already scheduled that day, use 19:00 the next day.
   A Short and a long video may share a day only if their times are at least `min_gap_hours_short_long` hours apart, still inside the window.
4. Write `output/upload.json`:
   - channel_key, channel_name, channel_id (from `channels/<key>/channel.json`)
   - format: "long" or "short"
   - Short: parent_video_id = the long video's id if the Short is cut from a long video (null for a stand-alone Short). The script then puts "पूरी कहानी यहाँ देखें 👉 <long URL>" at the top of the description and, after upload, schedules the first comment (task StoryChannel-Comment-<video_id>, publish_at + 5 min, tools/post_comment.py) and writes "related_video: pending, pin_comment: pending" to channels/<key>/log.md.
   - title, description, tags (from the approved metadata file)
   - video: final mp4 (never *_preview*)
   - thumbnail, captions (.srt), language "hi", captions_name "Hindi"
   - made_for_kids, contains_synthetic_media, category_id
   - publish_at like 2026-10-21T19:00:00+05:30 (or privacy "private" with no publish_at)
   - playlist_id if configured
5. `python tools/youtube_upload.py --job <upload.json> --dry-run`. Fix any PROBLEMS.
   If the script says WRONG CHANNEL, stop and tell the user; never edit channel_id to make it pass.
6. Show the user: title, publish time IST, made-for-kids, playlist, thumbnail file. Wait for ha/ok.
7. Run without --dry-run. If thumbnail/captions/playlist failed, fix the cause and run with `--extras-only`.
8. Report: video URL, studio URL, what succeeded, and what still needs a click in Studio (schedule if locked private, pinned comment, end screen). Pinning a comment is not possible through the API.
8b. Short with a parent: show the user the manual checklist (Studio: Related video = long video; pin the first comment once it is posted) — RULES section 8.
9. Append a PUBLISHED line to `channels/<key>/log.md` and update the story's `story.md` status.
```

```text
## 8. Publishing
- Fixed publish times: long video at 19:00 IST, its Short at 21:00 IST the same day.
  - Long upload finished before 18:45 IST -> long publishes 19:00 the same day; otherwise 19:00 the next day.
  - Short upload finished before 20:45 IST -> Short publishes 21:00 the same day as its long; otherwise both move to the next day.
  - A Short not made from a long (e.g. Dadi Jasoos case) also publishes at 21:00.
- Per day per channel: at most one long (19:00) and one Short (21:00).
- Planned frequency: long videos 2-3 per week, Shorts daily (from stories already made, ₹0).
- Nothing goes Public or gets scheduled without the user's OK in that conversation.
- One upload per video. If `output/upload_result.json` exists, do not upload again.
- Short -> Long link (MANDATORY): every Short made from a long video must (a) have the long video's URL in its description with a short CTA line, (b) get an automatic first comment "पूरी कहानी यहाँ देखें 👉 <long URL>" posted right after it becomes public, and (c) the user sets in Studio: Related video = the long video, and pins that comment. The YouTube API cannot set Related video or pin comments, so (c) stays manual; Munshi shows this checklist after every Short upload and asks about it at the start of the next session until the user confirms.
```

shared/RULES.md me naya section jodo (bilkul isi text ke saath), aur step-review skill ke Script, Preview, Final, Thumbnail aur Metadata stages me "Algorithm: run RULES section 13 checks." jodo.

## 13. Audience & algorithm (CTR, retention, session)
Long videos:
- Hook: the first spoken line must start within 1.0 s. The first 30 s must set up the story's main question or conflict. Any frame/intro before the story itself (Dadi-Golu opening) is max 10 s.
- Promise kept: whatever the title and thumbnail promise (e.g. the magic cauldron) must appear on screen within the first 60 s. A title/thumbnail that promises something the video does not show is a BLOCKER (misleading).
- Visual change: no single shot stays without a cut or new camera move for more than 8 s.
- End: the last 20 s carry no essential visuals or captions in the end-screen area, so end-screen elements can sit there. The last spoken line asks viewers one specific question about the story (for comments), not a generic "like and subscribe".
Shorts:
- First frame is a strong visual (no title card, no black frame). First word within 0.5 s.
- Length 30-58 s.
- Captions and key visuals stay out of the bottom 20% and right 15% (YouTube buttons).
- Ending is either a cliffhanger towards the long video or a clean loop back to the first frame.
Thumbnail:
- Readable at phone size: Munshi downscales it to 160x90 px and checks the main face/emotion and the text are still recognisable.
- One clear focal point (a face with strong emotion or the key object), max 4 words, high contrast.
Title:
- The hook words come in the first 40 characters (mobile cuts long titles). Curiosity is fine, misleading is not.
Session:
- Every long video goes into its channel playlist, gets an end screen (next video + subscribe), and every Short from it has Related video = that long (manual Studio checklist).
Severity: a misleading title/thumbnail is a BLOCKER; the rest are FIX in R1 and MINOR after R2 (section 11).

Phir sync.

- **Long intro max 10 sec:** script me intro lines par `"part": "intro"` lagana hoga. Intro 10 sec se lamba ho, ya ye mark na ho, toh builder "SECTION 13" warning deta hai.
- **Aakhri line ek khaas sawaal:** long video ki aakhri boli gayi line sawaal na ho toh builder warning deta hai. Naya script template `channels/_template/.../script/script.md` banaya, jisme intro ≤10 sec aur aakhir me sawaal ka dhaancha hai. step-review ke Script stage me bhi ye yaad dilaya.
- **Short captions:** left aur right dono taraf 170 px margin, taki text beech me rahe aur right 15% khali rahe. Neeche 480 px (25%) ka margin hai. Shorts ki lambai ka check ab 30–58 sec hai.
- **Test:** Long 01 par dono warnings aayi, jo sahi hai kyunki purana video hai. Short 01 par koi warning nahi aayi.
- **`carry_over.md`:** teeno issues "fixed in pipeline" ke saath likh diye.

## Sync aur repo size
- `pushed: review files out of git (reports only), JPG frames; RULES 13 builder defaults + carry-over`
- **GitHub repo: 338.4 MB.** Purani history me jo review images ja chuki hain, wo tab tak rahengi jab tak history dobara na likhi jaye (force-push). Wo jokhim wala kaam hai, isliye nahi kiya.
- Sync log ka "387 MB" aapke computer par git ki do pack files ka jod hai. `git gc` se ye ghatkar ~338 MB ho jayega. Kahein toh chala doon.
